title: seL4 verification proofs
summary: Isabelle/HOL specifications and proofs for the seL4 microkernel, including refinement, access control, confidentiality and binary verification developments.
assumptions: Proof sessions use the architecture selected by L4V_ARCH and the C and Haskell specifications generated by the upstream build.

license.attribution: README and license documentation: Copyright 2020 Data61, CSIRO, CC-BY-SA-4.0. Proofs and tools have per-file licenses, typically GPL-2.0-only or BSD-2-Clause; inspect file headers before reuse.

reuse: Follow the upstream setup guide to install the proof dependencies and Isabelle through the repo manifest. From the l4v directory, select the architecture with L4V_ARCH and run the proof suite.

contents: Abstract, design-level and C specifications of the kernel.
Refinement proofs, access-control proofs and information-flow proofs.
capDL specifications, system-initialisation proofs and reusable Isabelle libraries.
